initiatives.name: Bean Enterprise Management System
initiatives.overview: Building a multi-tenant enterprise management platform designed to centralize business operations, connecting inventory, sales, branch management, and internal ticketing through a unified system.
initiatives.contribution: Architected and developed the majority of the backend using Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, implementing authentication, email-verified registration, role-based permissions, PostgreSQL-backed sessions, and audit logging. Also own the DevOps side of the startup: setting up staging, UAT, and production environments and configuring domains and subdomains.
initiatives.highlight: Built most of the multi-tenant backend and run the startup infrastructure across staging, UAT, and production, including domain and subdomain configuration.
initiatives.statusNote: Active pilot deployment live at pilot.bean.enterprises/operations.

initiatives.label: Retail POS & Business Operating System
initiatives.name: Clementine BOS
initiatives.overview: A mission-critical retail Business Operating System engineered for neighbourhood shops and micro-retailers. Built to power counter sales, barcode scanning, append-only stock ledgers, and cashier governance with high resilience on unreliable networks.
initiatives.contribution: Architected and engineered the Android cashier application in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose with on-device ML Kit barcode scanning and crash-safe cart persistence. Designed the Spring Boot REST backend with Flyway migrations, pessimistic row-level locking for zero-race-condition transactions, and idempotent sales handling.
initiatives.highlight: Native Android POS with on-device ML barcode scanning and an idempotent Spring Boot backend with append-only inventory ledgers.
initiatives.statusNote: Targeting production deployment and Google Play Store distribution.

Modern native UI with Jetpack Compose & Material 3

capabilities.name: Inventory & governance

initiatives.label: Quantitative Trading / Software Engineering
initiatives.name: Tangerine
initiatives.overview: An actively developed quantitative cryptocurrency trading platform exploring market-data infrastructure, systematic research, model evaluation, risk governance, and controlled execution. It treats research, evaluation, risk controls, and execution as one auditable system rather than a generic trading bot.
initiatives.contribution: Designing and building the platform end to end: backend services, a persistence layer with versioned migrations, a model-evaluation workflow, and a frontend for research and monitoring.
initiatives.highlight: One auditable pipeline from market data through model evaluation to risk-governed, controlled execution.
initiatives.statusNote: Not a finished commercial product. The source code is private; a separate showcase site previews the interface and engineering scope.

initiatives.label: Open-Source Reference / Payment Correctness
initiatives.name: reliable-ledger
initiatives.overview: A reference payment ledger in Express 5 and PostgreSQL, built from scratch to show the correctness patterns behind my commercial work without exposing that work's code.
initiatives.contribution: Designed and implemented idempotent transfers with request hashing and response replay, ordered row locking, a double-entry ledger, an append-only audit log enforced by database triggers, and a transactional outbox worker. Documented each decision in an ADR.
initiatives.highlight: 20 concurrent duplicate requests produce exactly one transfer, and 50 parallel withdrawals never overdraw. Both are tested against real PostgreSQL in CI.
initiatives.statusNote: 21 integration tests pass in CI on every push. Known limitations are listed in the README.

capabilities.name: Idempotency
items: Concurrent duplicates serialized by primary key

capabilities.name: Transaction safety
items: FOR UPDATE locks in fixed order
No overdraft, no deadlock under concurrency

capabilities.name: Auditability
items: Append-only audit log (UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE rejected)
Ledger invariant: balance = sum of entries

capabilities.name: Delivery
items: SKIP LOCKED workers, exponential backoff, dead-letter

initiatives.label: Developer Tooling / AI Agents
initiatives.name: claude-harness
initiatives.overview: A Claude Code plugin of skills, commands and hooks that keeps coding agents inside a project's declared architecture, hardens request/response paths, hands work between sessions, slices big tasks into gated milestones and produces evidence-based QA reports.
initiatives.contribution: Built all five planned phases: the architecture skill and style registry, the request/response hardening skill, the /switch context handoff with hooks, Project Dam for incremental milestones, and a QA report generator with redaction. Added a debug protocol and an always-on knowledge-placement rule, plus the CI validators and tests.
initiatives.highlight: CI validates every skill and spec, runs the unit tests, and diffs a generated QA report against a golden file on every push.
initiatives.statusNote: All five phases done, plus the debug protocol and knowledge placement. Free (MIT).

capabilities.name: Quality
items: QA report generator (Markdown, optional .docx) with redaction
Debug protocol: reproduce, isolate, fix with proof

capabilities.name: Guardrails
items: Secret scan, validators and tests in CI

initiatives.label: Survival Horror Game / 3D Engine Architecture
initiatives.name: Cold Friend, Come In
initiatives.overview: A first-person atmospheric winter survival horror game built in Java 21 with jMonkeyEngine 3.9. Features a deterministic procedural wilderness generation pipeline, real-time diurnal lighting, and topologically verified reachability across a 1.5 km² winter expanse.
initiatives.contribution: Architected the game as a zero-warning modular monolith with strict domain isolation (zero engine dependencies in simulation packages). Implemented the seeded world generator (noise, hydraulic river carving, 40,000+ instanced environmental entities) and thermodynamic survival mechanics.
initiatives.highlight: Deterministic 1.5 km² procedural world generator with topological reachability validation, running at ~600 FPS on Java 21.
initiatives.statusNote: Foundation and procedural world generator complete; preparing for itch.io release.

capabilities.name: World generation
items: Hydraulic river carving and downhill descent

capabilities.name: Simulation & systems
items: Real-time diurnal clock & dynamic sky lighting
